occurrences.finding: Education Outside of U.S.: One employee did not have their education diploma translated to english.

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Children's Product Certification: Operation Product Certification form was not currently signed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Children's Product Certification (26 TAC §746.801(18))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2985): Director did not have a signed and notorized form 2985.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2985) (26 TAC §746.901(4))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training Area - 24 Hours Required: Two Caregivers were missing training on hazardous materials.  Three employees were missing training on food allergy emergency.  Director missing training on medication administration.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training Area - 24 Hours Required (26 TAC §746.1309(a))

occurrences.finding: Report Number of Employees: Operation has not reported their staffing changes for the year 2024 by the due date of 1/15/2025.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Number of Employees (26 TAC §746.303(b))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Limitations or Restrictions: The special needs statement for one child's file was still left blank.

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Limitations or Restrictions: As of today, July 17th, 2024 the operation has not submitted the documentation showing completed special needs statements as they were missing the limitations and restrictions portion. The statements were left blank.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Limitations or Restrictions (26 TAC §746.605(13)(A))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information-Completed Food Allergy Plan: As of today July 17th, 2024 the operation has not provided documentation of a signed Food Allergy Emergency Plan for a child with a diagnosed food allergy.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information-Completed Food Allergy Plan (26 TAC §746.605(16))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Limitations or Restrictions: Children's files evaluated still did not contain complete special needs statements and were missing the limitations and restrictions portion. The statements were left blank.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Limitations or Restrictions (26 TAC §746.605(13)(A))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information-Completed Food Allergy Plan: Documentation of a signed Food Allergy Emergency Plan was still not available for review for a child with a diagnosed food allergy.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information-Completed Food Allergy Plan (26 TAC §746.605(16))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records: Staff files evaluated were missing the following information:    - 3 were missing signed statements showing orientation was given  - 2 were missing notarized licensing affidavit forms  - 2 were missing proof of meeting the minimum education requirements
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records (26 TAC §746.901)

occurrences.finding: Employee record: Signed and Dated Statement for Orientation/Pre-Service training  by trainer and employee: 3 out of 9 staff files evaluated did not contain signed documentation showing orientation was given.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Employee record: Signed and Dated Statement for Orientation/Pre-Service training  by trainer and employee (26 TAC §746.1329(d))

occurrences.finding: CPR Training and Recertification Adhere to Guidelines-skill based: Documentation of the skill-based portion of pediatic CPR training was not available to review for 1 staff file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: CPR Training and Recertification Adhere to Guidelines-skill based (26 TAC §746.1315(b)(1))

occurrences.finding: First Aid Kit - Supplies Not Expired: The alcohol wipes in the first aid kit have expired as of March 2024.
occurrences.violation_type_title: First Aid Kit - Supplies Not Expired (26 TAC §746.4003(b))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: 3 out of 10 children's files evaluated did not contain immunization records.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §746.603(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Admission Information: 10 children's files were evaluated and were missing the following information:    -Complete Emergency Contact Information  -Complete Emergency Medical Treatment and Transportation Authorization Information
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Admission Information (26 TAC §746.603(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information-Completed Food Allergy Plan: Documentation of a signed Food Allergy Emergency Plan was not available for review for a child with a diagnosed food allergy.

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Limitations or Restrictions: Children's files evaluated did not contain complete special needs statements and were missing the limitations and restrictions portion. The statements were left blank.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Limitations or Restrictions (26 TAC §746.605(13)(A))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for: A caregiver did not know the correct number of children they were responsible for during the inspection. The caregiver stated only 10 children were present when there were actually 11 children present.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training - Remaining training hour topics: 5 out of 9 staff files evaluated were missing the following training topics:    -Emergency Preparedness  -Handling, Storing and Disposing of Hazardous Materials  -Preventing and Controlling the Spread of Communicable Diseases  -Responding to Food Allergies  -Understanding Building and Physical Premises Safety
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training - Remaining training hour topics (26 TAC §746.1309(f))

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months: As of today, the annual fire inspection has still not been conducted since March 18th, 2022.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))

occurrences.finding: Requirement of Gas Leak Inspection: The gas leak inspection has not been conducted since April 2022.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirement of Gas Leak Inspection (26 TAC §746.5401)

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Liability Insurance: Documentation of current liability insurance was not available for review during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Liability Insurance (26 TAC §746.801(6))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Monthly Maintenance Checklist: Documentation of monthly maintenance checklists were not available for review during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Monthly Maintenance Checklist (26 TAC §746.4751(b))

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months: The annual fire inspection has not been conducted since March 18th, 2022.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Safety Documentation for Emergency Drills, Fire Extinguishers, & Smoke Detectors: Documentation of recent emergency fire, severe weather, shelter in place and lock down drills were not available for review during the inspection. There was also no documentation showing the fire extinguishers, smoke detectors and carbon monoxide detectors have been tested monthly.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Safety Documentation for Emergency Drills, Fire Extinguishers, & Smoke Detectors (26 TAC §746.801(10))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records Maintained: Records were evaluated for ten children enrolled and the following was determined:    -Four children needed a special needs statement.  -Two children needed immunization records.  -One child needed an emergency contact information.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records Maintained (26 TAC §746.603(a))
